Visitor replaces embedded iframe with custom text

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorIframeCustom struct{
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorIframeCustom) VisitIframe(ctx htmd.NodeContext, src *string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(`[EMBEDDED: https://maps.example.com/embed]`)
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorIframeCustom{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>Embedded map:</p><iframe src="https://maps.example.com/embed" width="400" height="300"></iframe><p>End of map</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
